definitions.explanation: A surface or view produced by cutting straight across an object, perpendicular to its long axis. Used in engineering, anatomy, and geology.

examples.japanese: {横断面|おうだんめん}を{図|ず}に{描|えが}く。
examples.english: Draw a cross section in a diagram.

examples.japanese: {木|き}の{横断面|おうだんめん}に{年輪|ねんりん}が{見|み}える。
examples.english: Growth rings are visible in the cross section of the tree.

examples.japanese: トンネルの{横断面|おうだんめん}を{見|み}ると、{構造|こうぞう}がよく{分|わ}かる。
examples.english: Looking at the cross section of the tunnel makes its structure clear.

notes:
Compound of {横断|おうだん} (crossing transversely) and {面|めん} (surface, face).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {横断面|おうだんめん}{図|ず}: cross-sectional diagram
- {横断面|おうだんめん}を{取|と}る: to take a cross section

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {断面|だんめん}: cross section, cut surface — the general term, without specifying direction
- {縦断面|じゅうだんめん}: longitudinal section — a cut along the long axis
